name: claude-skills-marketplace
description: A collection of Claude Code skills with specialised workflows and domain expertise for software engineering tasks

plugins.name: rust-warning-reduction
plugins.description: Identify and iteratively eliminate high-frequency Clippy warnings using the Li et al. (arXiv:2310.11738) Pareto-based methodology. Provides warn-identify (ranked warning distribution) and warn-reduce (iterative elimination loop that stops at 18/KLOC).

plugins.name: gdb-debugging
plugins.description: Debug compiled programs (Rust, C, C++) using GDB instead of print statements. Observe-first approach: inspect call stack, variables, and execution flow without modifying code.

plugins.name: hermes-tweet
plugins.description: Native Hermes Agent X/Twitter research, reading, monitoring, and opt-in posting workflows.
